Languages Proficiency Level

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("Scale 1–5, where 5 = fluent, 1 = beginner")
languages = ['English', 'Hindi', 'Malayalam', 'Tamil', 'Arabic', 'Japanese']
levels = [5, 4, 5, 3, 2, 1]   

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.barh(languages, levels, color='skyblue')
plt.xlabel('Proficiency Level (1 = Beginner, 5 = Fluent)')
plt.title('Language Proficiency Levels')
plt.xlim(0, 5)
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.show()
```
